_about: Google Flow(Veo) 사진->영상 프롬프트. 벤치마크 릴스 5개, 장면 91개에서 자주 나온 움직임을 장면 종류별로 묶었다. 최종 프롬프트 = presets[종류].prompt + ' ' + common_suffix. 릴스에는 클립 앞부분 1~1.5초만 쓰므로 움직임이 첫 프레임부터 시작해야 한다.
common_suffix: Motion starts immediately from the first frame. Smooth, slow, stabilized gimbal movement, natural real-estate cinematography, photorealistic. Keep the architecture, furniture, layout, colors and lighting exactly as in the reference image. Do not add or remove objects, people, text, logos or signs. No camera shake, no warping, no morphing.

hook_pov_door.name: 훅: 1인칭 문 열고 들어가기
hook_pov_door.use_for: 첫 장면. 현관문, 대문, 객실 문 사진
hook_pov_door.prompt: First-person POV shot: a hand reaches in from the bottom of the frame and pushes the door open, then the camera glides forward through the doorway, revealing the space beyond.
hook_pov_door.note: 손이 나오는 연출이다. 문 사진이 없으면 exterior_aerial 이나 pool_day 로 시작한다.

exterior_aerial.name: 외관 드론 (낮)
exterior_aerial.use_for: 숙소 전경, 단지 전체, 산·바다 배경 외관
exterior_aerial.prompt: Slow aerial drone push-in with a gentle descent toward the property. Trees sway softly in the breeze and clouds drift slowly across the sky.

exterior_night.name: 외관 야경 (밤·해질녘)
exterior_night.use_for: 불 켜진 외관, 조명 있는 글램핑·카라반 야경
exterior_night.prompt: Slow drone push-in at blue hour. Warm interior lights glow through the windows, string lights twinkle softly, reflections shimmer gently on the water.

pool_day.name: 수영장·온수풀 (낮)
pool_day.use_for: 야외 수영장, 인피니티 풀, 중정 온수풀
pool_day.prompt: Slow forward glide just above the water surface toward the view. Gentle ripples move across the water and sunlight caustics shimmer on the pool floor, light steam rises from the warm water, clouds drift slowly.

pool_night.name: 수영장 (밤)
pool_night.prompt: Slow push-in toward the illuminated pool. Warm steam drifts over the water, underwater lights shimmer through gentle ripples, string lights twinkle.

waterfall.name: 폭포·분수가 있는 풀
waterfall.prompt: Very slow push-in. The waterfall pours continuously into the pool, splashing and sending ripples and fine mist across the water surface.

hot_tub.name: 노천탕·자쿠지·욕조
hot_tub.use_for: 개별 노천탕, 히노키탕, 자쿠지, 반신욕 통, 욕조
hot_tub.prompt: Slow push-in toward the tub. Thick steam rises and curls from the hot water, the water surface ripples gently, leaves sway softly in the background.

sauna.name: 사우나
sauna.use_for: 핀란드 사우나 실내, 사우나 난로, 사우나 돌
sauna.prompt: Slow push-in. Fire flickers inside the wood-burning stove, heat haze shimmers and wisps of steam rise from the hot sauna stones.

firepit_night.name: 불멍·캠프파이어
firepit_night.prompt: Slow push-in toward the fire pit. Flames dance and flicker, small sparks float upward, warm firelight flickers across the nearby chairs, string lights twinkle overhead.

bbq_food.name: 바베큐·음식
bbq_food.prompt: Close shot with a slight push-in. Food sizzles on the grill, smoke and steam rise, embers glow and flicker beneath the grate.

bedroom.name: 침실
bedroom.prompt: Slow dolly-in toward the bed at eye level. Sheer curtains sway gently in a breeze, soft daylight slowly shifts across the white bedding, the duvet fabric moves slightly.

room_reveal.name: 거실·복층·넓은 공간 (옆으로 이동)
room_reveal.use_for: 복층, 거실, 주방, 다이닝, 긴 복도
room_reveal.prompt: Slow lateral truck from left to right revealing the space, with gentle parallax between foreground furniture and the background windows. Soft daylight streams in.

window_view.name: 창밖 뷰·통창·천창
window_view.use_for: 통창, 천창, 창밖 숲·바다·산 풍경, 커튼 있는 창
window_view.prompt: Slow tilt up from the room toward the window. Outside, tree branches sway in the breeze and clouds drift; sheer curtains billow softly and sunlight shifts inside the room.

beach_sea.name: 바다·해변·갯벌
beach_sea.prompt: Slow drone glide along the shoreline. Waves roll onto the sand and retreat with white foam, clouds drift slowly over the sea.

forest_path.name: 숲길·산책로·데크
forest_path.prompt: Slow forward glide along the path. Leaves and branches sway gently, dappled sunlight flickers across the ground.

amenity_detail.name: 어메니티·소품·웰컴 푸드
amenity_detail.use_for: 웰컴 간식, 어메니티, 커피머신, 소품 클로즈업
amenity_detail.prompt: Static close shot with a very slow push-in. Soft light shifts gently across the objects, a faint shadow moves across the table.

people_optional.name: (선택) 사람 연출
people_optional.use_for: 사람이 있으면 분위기가 사는 장면. 책 읽기, 건배, 노천탕에 앉기
people_optional.prompt: A guest sits relaxed, reading a book and slowly turning a page, natural subtle movement, camera holds steady with a very slow push-in.
people_optional.note: 사진에 없는 사람을 넣는 연출이라 common_suffix 의 'Do not add ... people' 을 빼고 쓴다. AI 생성 표시 대상.

season_edits._about: 벤치마크 v2(겨울 눈), v4·v5(단풍)는 원본 사진의 계절을 바꾼 뒤 영상화했다. 사진->영상 프롬프트만으로는 계절이 거의 안 바뀌므로(직접 테스트한 천창 영상에서 확인) 먼저 이미지를 편집하고 그 이미지를 영상화한다. 시설·구조는 바꾸지 않는다.
season_edits.winter_snow: Edit this photo: keep the exact same building, room, furniture and composition. Change the season to winter: thick fresh snow covers the trees, ground and roof edges outside, soft overcast winter light. Everything inside stays unchanged.
season_edits.autumn: Edit this photo: keep the exact same building, furniture and composition. Change the trees and plants outside to vivid red, orange and golden autumn foliage under soft warm light. Everything else stays unchanged.
season_edits.blue_hour: Edit this photo: keep the exact same building and composition. Change the time to blue hour just after sunset: deep blue sky, warm interior lights switched on and glowing through the windows, outdoor string lights on. Everything else stays unchanged.
season_edits.snowfall_motion: Snow falls gently and steadily outside, flakes drifting past the window.

order_hint: 벤치마크 흐름: 훅(문 열기·야경·가장 강한 풀) -> 시설(풀·탕·사우나) -> 객실 -> 밤(불멍·야경, 60~80% 지점) -> 마지막(창밖 뷰·전경)
